leadText:
Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon – Ultra Legends is the twenty-second season of the dubbed version of the Pokémon animated series. It is the third and final season of Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. The season follows and as they continue attending the Pokémon School and conclude their school year by participating in the Alola region's first-ever Pokémon League Conference.

In , it premiered on Disney XD on March 23, 2019 with the dub premiere of Lillier and the Staff!, and concluded on March 7, 2020 with Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!. It originally aired in the United States as part of the 2019-2020 Disney XD Saturday morning lineup. In , it debuted on March 2, 2019 on Teletoon.

It is preceded by Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures and succeeded by Pokémon Journeys: The Series, the first season of the dub of the eponymous series, which is based on the Generation VIII .

Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon – Ultra Legends is the twenty-second season of the dubbed version of the Pokémon animated series. It is the third and final season of Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. The season follows and as they continue attending the Pokémon School and conclude their school year by participating in the Alola region's first-ever Pokémon League Conference.

In , it premiered on Disney XD on March 23, 2019 with the dub premiere of Lillier and the Staff!, and concluded on March 7, 2020 with Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!. It originally aired in the United States as part of the 2019-2020 Disney XD Saturday morning lineup. In , it debuted on March 2, 2019 on Teletoon.

It is preceded by Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures and succeeded by Pokémon Journeys: The Series, the first season of the dub of the eponymous series, which is based on the Generation VIII .

==Blurb==
 
 Ash has completed three of his four grand trials in the Alola region, and more adventures await as he and his classmates acquire new Z-Crystals, make new Pokémon friends, and learn how to Mantine Surf! In their role as Ultra Guardians, the Pokémon School students take on an important mission to protect Wela Volcano. Ash meets a new rival, Hau, whose Dartrix offers Rowlet quite a challenge. Even Rotom Dex gets an adventure of its own when our heroes visit the set of its favorite TV show! And Professor Kukui's dream of starting a Pokémon League in Alola just might be getting closer to reality...
